note: Seed: top-level stages only, taken from the narrative spine. Everything below level 1 must come from papers.

HYP.definition: Motivation, knowledge gap, or hypothesis that the work sets out to test

DES.definition: Choice of material system, composition, architecture or route, made for a stated reason

PRC.definition: A processing act or condition applied to make or modify the material

OBS.definition: A readout from a measurement or computation, before interpretation. Carries a modality

STR.definition: A claim about the material's structure at any scale, inferred from observations

PRP.definition: A claim about an intrinsic property of the material

PRF.definition: A claim about performance in a use condition or device

MEC.definition: A mechanistic explanation linking cause to effect

KNW.definition: Prior knowledge, literature or theory brought in as a premise

DSC.definition: Discussion: generalisation, comparison to prior work, limitation, outlook

rels.motivates: HYP/DSC gives reason for a DES/PRC choice or a test
rels.realizes: a DES choice is carried out by a PRC act
rels.produces: a PRC act or condition yields a structural state
rels.causes: one state/claim leads to another (structure → property → performance)
rels.explains: a MEC accounts for a claim
rels.premise_for: KNW is used as a premise for an inference
rels.contrasts: a claim or OBS is compared against a control, baseline or alternative
rels.rules_out: evidence or reasoning rejects an alternative explanation
